title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: IntelliFrame people labels name in-room participants
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, automatic enablement and Teams Rooms Pro entitlement agree with Microsoft's notice and documentation. The recognition controls and narrowly stated documentation gaps are supported; the page appropriately distinguishes the notice's enrollment policy from its replacement in Learn.

claims.quote: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <PolicyName> -roomAttributeUserOverride Attribute -roomPeopleNameUserOverride On enables meeting-policy-based recognition.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity PolicyName -roomAttributeUserOverride Attribute -roomPeopleNameUserOverride On

claims.claim: roomPeopleNameUserOverride uses On or Off to control video-based identification and name labels.
claims.quote: roomPeopleNameUserOverride | Control the video-based user identification in meeting rooms. | Off - The room won't send video for identification. On - Room users captured by supported cameras will be identified.

claims.claim: The notice names the same setting as RoomPeopleNameUserOverride.
claims.quote: Enable name display in rooms: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -RoomPeopleNameUserOverride On.

claims.claim: Learn gives no Teams admin center path for roomPeopleNameUserOverride.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams Rooms roomPeopleNameUserOverride Teams admin center meeting policy configuration UI'; read teams-rooms-people-recognition and search excerpts from Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and copilot-admin-mtr. No UI route for this parameter documented.

claims.claim: The recognition device-setting route is Teams Pro Management Portal > Rooms > Settings > Recognition > Configure with device settings > Apply > Submit.
claims.quote: Select Rooms. Select Settings followed by the Recognition tab. Enable Configure with device settings. Modify to the desired configuration. Select Apply. Choose when to apply the settings change and select Submit.

claims.claim: Recognition settings can also be configured locally on the room console.
claims.quote: On the Teams Room console, go to Settings > Recognition. Select Configure with device settings (Recommended). Turn on Voice recognition and/or Face recognition as applicable.

claims.claim: Learn documents no API equivalent for the Pro Management Portal recognition device settings.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal recognition device settings API PowerShell face voice recognition' and 'Teams Rooms FaceRecognition VoiceRecognition ConfigureWithDeviceSettings XML SkypeSettings API recognition settings'; read people-recognition and release notes.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollVoice Disabled -EnrollFace Disabled disables active voice and face enrollment in the Global policy.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled
Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollVoice Disabled
Enabling these settings will allow your users in your organization the ability to enroll using active enrollment.

claims.claim: CsTeamsAIPolicy enrollment configuration is accessible only through PowerShell, not an admin UI.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can manage voice and face enrollment by using the CsTeamsAIPolicy. You can access this policy only through Microsoft PowerShell.

claims.claim: Express voice enrollment is controlled separately by PassiveVoiceEnrollment.
claims.quote: This is known as Express voice enrollment. This setting can also be individually set to Enabled or Disabled and operates independently of EnrollVoice.

claims.claim: Learn does not state precedence when both room device settings and meeting-policy recognition settings are configured.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams Rooms recognition device settings meeting policy precedence Configure with device settings'; opened teams-rooms-people-recognition, multistream-intelliframe and release notes. Sources describe alternatives but no explicit simultaneous-setting precedence.

claims.claim: Teams admin center can show end-user voice and face enrollment status.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can now use Teams admin center to view end-user voice and face enrollment status and manage enrolled data directly from the admin experience. Enterprise administrators can also delete end-user voice and face profiles

claims.claim: The cited enrollment page provides no navigation path for viewing or deleting enrollment profiles in Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams admin center voice face enrollment status delete profiles navigation Recognition CsTeamsAIPolicy'; opened voice-and-face-recognition in full. Its management section and FAQ describe the capability but provide no navigation steps.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot export end-user voice or face enrollment data from Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can't export end-user voice or face enrollment data from the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: Users can enroll in Teams > Settings > Recognition.
claims.quote:
Encourage users to enroll in voice and face recognition: Teams > Settings > Recognition.
Individual users can opt out anytime by removing their profile in Teams > Settings > Recognition.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms release notes describe the portal recognition settings as replacing PowerShell-based configuration.
claims.quote: we're introducing new admin-facing settings in the Teams Pro Management Portal. These settings replace PowerShell-based configuration with a more intuitive UI
